changeSet.comment: Create table for internal per-issue chat messages between project members
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS REMSFAL.issue_chat_messages ( project_id UUID, issue_id UUID, message_id UUID, sender_id UUID, sender_name TEXT, message TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMP, modified_at TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY ((project_id, issue_id), message_id) ) WITH CLUSTERING ORDER BY (message_id ASC);
